source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 22 februarie — «Sfântul Cuvios Atanasie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 22ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Όσιος Αθανάσιος ο Ομολογητής της Μονής Παυλοπετρίου»

attestations.note: The Greek line gives him the monastery the Romanian line did not: Paulopetrion, which the page puts in the gulf of Nicomedia between the villages of Panteichion and Touzla. It ties him to Theodore the Studite and to John abbot of the monastery of Kathara, and has him exiled in the iconoclast persecution «Επί αυτοκράτορα Λέοντος του Ισαύρου (813 - 820 μ.Χ.)» — the years are Leo V the Armenian's, whom the page calls the Isaurian; the mismatch is the page's own.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

floruit.display: under the emperor the page calls Leo the Isaurian
floruit.note: saint.gr: «Επί αυτοκράτορα Λέοντος του Ισαύρου (813 - 820 μ.Χ.) καταδιώχθηκε και αυτός μαζί με άλλους Ομολογητές της πίστεως υπέρ των αγίων εικόνων και εξορίσθηκε.» The interval is the reign the page prints. Those years are Leo V the Armenian's and not Leo III the Isaurian's; the mismatch is recorded and not corrected, because the source's reading is the fact. The page gives no year for his repose.
